title: Immunoglobulin Isotypes & Antigen Memory

sourceEvidence.quote:
Immunoglobulin
isotypes
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote: All isotypes can exist as monomers.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote:
Mature, naïve B cells prior to activation express IgM and IgD
on their surfaces.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote:
They may differentiate in germinal centers of lymph nodes by isotype switching
(gene rearrangement; induced by cytokines and CD40L) into plasma cells that secrete IgA, IgG,
or IgE.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.claim: FA printed mnemonic (verification only — not reproduced in user-facing note)
sourceEvidence.quote: “For B cells, IgMom and IgDad mature to plasma cells as they AGE.”
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote: Affinity refers to the strength of a single antibody–antigen interaction.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote:
Avidity (enhanced by the
hinge region and heavy chain domains) describes the overall binding strength resulting from
multiple antibody–antigen interactions in a multivalent molecule.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote: IgG
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote: Main antibody in 2° response to an antigen. Most abundant isotype in serum.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote:
Fixes complement,
opsonizes bacteria, neutralizes bacterial toxins and viruses.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote:
Only isotype that crosses the placenta
(provides infants with passive immunity that starts to wane after birth).
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote:
“IgG Greets the Growing
fetus.”
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.claim: IgG — warm AIHA + FA mnemonic (verification only)
sourceEvidence.quote:
Associated with warm autoimmune
hemolytic anemia (“warm weather is Good!”).
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote: IgA
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote: Prevents attachment of bacteria and viruses to mucous membranes; does not fix complement.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote: Monomer (in circulation) or dimer (with J chain when secreted).
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote:
Crosses epithelial cells by
transcytosis.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote:
Produced in GI tract (eg, by Peyer patches) and protects against gut infections (eg,
Giardia).
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote: Most produced antibody overall, but has lower serum concentrations.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote:
Released into
secretions (tears, saliva, mucus) and breast milk.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote:
Picks up secretory component from epithelial cells,
which protects the Fc portion from luminal proteases.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote: IgM
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote: First antibody to be produced during an immune response.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote:
Fixes complement. Antigen receptor
on the surface of B cells.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote: Monomer on B cell, pentamer with J chain when secreted.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote:
Pentamer
enables avid binding to antigen while humoral response evolves.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote:
Associated with cold autoimmune
hemolytic anemia.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote: IgD
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote: Expressed on the surface of mature, naïve B cells. Normally, low levels are detectable in serum.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote: IgE
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.claim: IgE — mast cells, type I, histamine
sourceEvidence.quote:
Binds mast cells and basophils; cross-links when exposed to allergen, mediating immediate (type I)
hypersensitivity through release of inflammatory mediators such as histamine.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote:
Contributes to
immunity to parasites by activating Eosinophils.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote: Antigen type and memory
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote:
Thymus-independent
antigens
Antigens lacking a peptide component (eg, lipopolysaccharides from gram ⊝ bacteria); cannot
be presented by MHC to T cells.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote:
Weakly immunogenic; vaccines often require boosters and
adjuvants (eg, capsular polysaccharide subunit of Streptococcus pneumoniae PPSV23 vaccine).
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote:
Thymus-dependent
antigens
Antigens containing a protein component (eg, diphtheria toxoid).
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote:
Class switching and immunologic
memory occur as a result of direct contact of B cells with Th cells.
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)

sourceEvidence.quote: J chain
sourceEvidence.verifiedHow: pdftotext text-layer containment on pinned pages (verify-evidence.ts)
